decisions.reason: The auditability change does not necessarily alter the dashboard's purpose or required decision information; the dashboard clauses in the message are already represented independently.
Ease of auditing does not change the model's government-submission use, presentation quality, or investment narrative.
The general auditability requirement does not change the accepted opex range, scope, provisional status, or assumption-flagging rule.
Requiring the model to be easy to audit does not necessarily change the required Excel format or the prohibition on PDF substitution.
Auditability does not modify the required conclusion or evidence standard concerning the necessity of availability-style payments.
The source establishes general model auditability but does not explicitly change the existing reference basis, provisional-input policy, or assumption-disclosure obligations.
The auditability change does not alter the network size, site typologies, authoritative site list, or treatment of missing site-level details.
The source does not change the provisional financing status, debt-equity split, interest rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
Model auditability does not resolve or change the AUD currency basis, 2031 price base, or the existing currency ambiguity.
The general auditability requirement does not change the debt schedule or DSCR coverage output.
Auditability does not alter the Case F and Case G definitions, availability-payment mechanism, or comparison requirement.
The auditability change does not modify the required program-wide cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.
